case.title: Agent remembers details given earlier in the same call
case.source: calleval: in-call recall; ElevenLabs prompting guide (elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-agents/best-practices/prompting-guide) ('Do not repeat information collection that already occurred')
case.goal: Book an appointment for tomorrow at 10 AM, any doctor and branch is fine
quirks: When asked, give your full name 'Anita Rao' once. Near the end ask: 'just to be sure, what name did you put the booking under?'
case.precondition: Customer gave her full name once and later asked what name the booking is under.
criteria: The agent asked for the customer's name at most once
When asked, the agent correctly said the booking name is Anita Rao
The agent did not re-ask for the date or time after the customer stated them

turns.text: Hi, this is Maya from Apollo Hospitals. How can I help you?
Hi Maya, I need to book an appointment for tomorrow at ten in the morning, please.
We have Dr. Prasad for General Medicine at Indiranagar and Koramangala, and Dr. Syed for Pediatrics at Koramangala. Whom would you like to see?
Any doctor and branch is totally fine with me.
The earliest available slot I have tomorrow is at 10 AM with Dr. Prasad at Indiranagar. Does that work for you?
Could you please confirm your full name for the booking?
My full name is Anita Rao.
I have you booked with Dr. Rajendra Prasad at Indiranagar tomorrow at 10 AM. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Just to be sure, what name did you put the booking under?
The booking is under Anita Rao.
That sounds right, thanks so much for your help and goodbye!
Thank you for calling Apollo Clinic. Have a wonderful day!
